raw:
Two workers are several meters ahead near the wheeled rack: one in black faces toward the wearer and the rack, while the worker in red stands beside it. Neither blocks the wearer’s path. The wearer has both hands on a large blue tray loaded with cartons, held directly within reach, and is approaching the open rack area on the right. The appropriate next step is to lift/guide the load securely onto the rack. Careful handling best protects the items and nearby workers.
